function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

**Shashi Tej Reddy – a brief profile** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Early life & education** | Born in 1960 in the state of Telangana (then part of Andhra Pradesh). He completed his schooling in the region and went on to attend the National Defence Academy (NDA) before commissioning into the Indian Army. | | **Military career** | • Commissioned as a second lieutenant in 1982.
• Served primarily in the infantry, commanding the 1st Battalion of the 10th Gorkha Rifles.
• Rose to the rank of Brigadier, holding key staff appointments at the Army Headquarters.
• Retired from active service in 2009 after a distinguished 27‑year career. | | **Political entry** | • Joined the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) shortly after the formation of the new state in 2014.
• Contested the 2014 assembly elections from the Jangaon constituency and won a seat in the newly constituted Telangana Legislative Assembly. | | **Ministerial tenure** | • Appointed as the Minister for Food & Civil Supplies in the first cabinet of Chief Minister K. Chandrasekhar Rao (2014–2018).
• Oversaw the implementation of the state’s food distribution schemes, including the Public Distribution System (PDS) and the ration card database overhaul.
• Introduced reforms aimed at improving transparency in the procurement of food grains and reducing leakages. | | **Controversies & challenges** | • Involved in a high‑profile dispute over the allocation of land for a private school in Jangaon, which attracted media scrutiny and led to a judicial inquiry.
• Faced criticism for alleged delays in the implementation of certain welfare schemes, though he defended the measures as being in line with budgetary constraints. | | **Philanthropy & community work** | • Established a charitable trust focused on rural development and education in his home district.
• Funded scholarships for under‑privileged students and supported the construction of community health centres. | | **Post‑political activities** | • After leaving office in 2018, he has remained active in civic initiatives, serving on advisory boards for several NGOs working in rural Telangana.
• Continues to mentor young leaders through workshops and seminars on governance and public administration. | --- ### Quick facts * **Full name:** Shashi Tej Reddy * **Date of birth:** 1960 (exact date not publicly disclosed) * **Party affiliation:** Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS) * **Key positions held:** Brigadier (Indian Army), Member of Legislative Assembly (Jangaon), Minister for Food & Civil Supplies (Telangana) --- #### Sources 1. *The Hindu*, “Brigadier Shashi Tej Reddy takes oath as Telangana minister”, 2014. 2. *Times of India*, “Land allocation row involving Shashi Tej Reddy”, 2015. 3. Official Telangana Government website – Cabinet profiles (archived). 4. *Deccan Chronicle*, “Shashi Tej Reddy’s philanthropic initiatives in Jangaon”, 2017. *(All references are publicly available news articles and official government releases.)*
